elf-b12-001.reason: Owner ruling 2026-10-09, in reply to the coordinator's recommendation on the X6 content concerns: retire, no replacement now. The passage has two internal tensions around the ridge's numbers. Paragraph 2 says the zenith reading 'improved by about three percent' and 'Feltrin will not credit that to Brackwell', yet paragraph 3, in the writer's voice, ends 'which is how a slightly better zenith number and twenty-three lost nights ended up describing the same ten seasons', which reads as crediting the better number to the new lighting and gives q3's option B ('That the code did improve the sky over the ridge, though by less than the shielding work would suggest') real pull. Paragraph 4 says that at Ashcombe, through 'the same decade', 'every number the ridge keeps got worse together', while paragraph 2 says the ridge's zenith reading improved. Preserve all candidate, sheet, audit and verdict history, but exclude the unit from every product-bank import.
